The '''Crystal Eater''' was the name given to a [[guid]] living on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]], when it was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Crystal Eater appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Ilum. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
